narrative.overview:
Alliance is drawn as a transit network, not a catalogue. Each solution is a colour-coded line, each module a station, services are interchanges, formations form the circular Académie line, and the demo request is the terminus. The ground is a cool enamel with white signage panels, ink-navy type and hairline rules; one night-navy family is reserved for contrast sections. Colour is spent at page scale: thick strokes, section spines, full colour bands, never sprinkled accents.

Display type is large and tight (Bricolage Grotesque, 800, tracking -0.035em); text is Figtree. Controls are fully round pills, content panels are modestly rounded (8px), and structure is drawn with 1px rules. The recognisable silhouette with content removed: coloured parallel strokes bending at 45 degrees with ringed stations.
keyCharacteristics: One accent per scope: --accent / --on-accent are set per product line and everything inside inherits them.
Ink-navy is the structural colour (type, primary buttons, rules); lines carry meaning.
Flat panels, hairline rules; shadows only on lifted previews and open menus.
Station vocabulary: ringed dots, white dots with ink ring, coloured roundels with a one-letter glyph.
Reveal-on-scroll and route spine motion, all disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Inside any scope exactly one line colour is active, delivered through --accent. Never place two line colours as competing accents in the same card; a multi-line view shows them as parallel strokes, not as decoration.

rules.name: The Ink On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text on orange and yellow is ink, never white. Take the on-colour from --on-accent.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display never exceeds 6rem and tracking never goes below -0.04em; headings use text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with night navy, long blur and negative spread; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do scope --accent to one line per section or card and take text colour from --on-accent.
Do build controls as full pills and panels at 8px radius with 1px rules.
Do keep every reveal and animation inside the reduced-motion fallback (visible by default, JS opts in).
Do reserve Night for contrast sections; use white text on it and #c4d2ff for secondary labels.
Do pair every colour signal with text (line name, station label); keep 44px minimum touch targets.
donts: Don't use the legacy admin tokens (--color-primary, --color-dark, Inter) on public pages.
Don't centre a hero over a row of equal icon cards, or alternate grey and white sections.
Don't use emoji as icons; icons are Lucide strokes (2px) or the roundel glyphs.
Don't use hard offset shadows or scatter line colours as decoration.
Don't invent figures, clients or claims in diagrams or previews.
